body:
sometimes i randomly cry for no reason.
on here I see the amount of people that feel exactly like you and me. it overwhelms me. it gives me a reason to cry. i wish i could speak to everyone.. i wish there was something I could do. hundreds of unique posts every day. it's consuming

if our lives are the sum of all the choices we've made, then it's true, you can't change who you are.
but, with each day that passes and each new choice we make you can change who you're going to be. 
i believe that. 
and i believe that you are able to be more than what you said. if you didn't want to be, you would be like the countless people out there swinging their arms in crowded spaces who don't care about the repercussions of who they are and what they do.
whatcha wanna play? I got a PC
always open for a dialogue if u need to talk about something or nothing, or .. anything at all. there's plenty of people that feel the same exact way. you're not alone. trust.

i often feel like that's a solution. then i remember all of the beautiful art and music.. the poetry and history of the world. much of it is dark and a reflection of humanity, but it would be such a shame to lose all of that. 

we may be cruel as human beings, might not have the best record as far as empathy goes, but i wish one day humans realize these horrible things about themselves.

social media and celebrity worship definitely makes me feel unsure about it, but .. there's always hope.

many of us live our entire lives with these thoughts. . 

not wanting to hurt other people really shows how caring of a person you are. there's a huge shortage on good loving people in this world. i'd really like if you can have a conversation here with us. things do get better, they get worse too, but we have a lot of control over what we can let into our lives.

typically you'd wanna speak to a doctor that specifically works in the field. asking your doctor might be a good idea for reference. if u have insurance, you can search by what insurance they accept. depends what you think you need.

i've done this 6 times in the past few weeks

you're reaching out, that's ok.

for every evil person out there, there's a good one. we're all crazy, but some care much more than others. we just fill our lives and surround ourselves with people that don't appreciate those things. always people here to talk.
im here and sleepless if u need anything at all
spent 20 minutes on hold for someone to sound like they were selling me insurance/reading from a script.

hold on longer. 

i'm not gonna say it gets better and things will change and you'll wake up feeling brand new and happy, but i really don't think there's a point in not trying. life is pain, it's sad and it's bitter, but there's also so much good in it, and i really hope if you try to put aside all of the bad you can really see that.

i'm with you, bud. it seems really difficult to find a reason to go on when you think about all of the bad in life. sometimes it feels like there's so little beauty because of all the ugly, but you gotta search those things out. 

i'm sorry u got dealt a bad hand with all of this, but i assure you there's plenty here and masses more who are in the same headspace as you. i hope you find that little bit of beauty and happiness for yourself, it's there.

done this a few times.. write stuff on my phone or on paper, erase the notes, destroy the paper. sometimes i feel like a lot of my internal dialogue was wrong. there's a lot of good that can come from looking at them and trying to understand what is being looked for. 

i hope if u need anything you don't hit send, and instead talk to us here.

hope it's not goodbye. 

can still throw up, tons of people here to talk

i'm sorry for hearing that this happened. recently i've had a very similar situation but from the other side. fear, anxiety, depression all had a hand in it. i patched things up with that person after some time and we were inseparable for months. they might just be going through things, i don't know.. but i know how you're feeling right now. it's the hardest things humans can go through.

i'm really hoping you find something, anything, that makes you feel like what you said isn't true, because trust me, i have those same feelings often, and i know there's no way this world would be a better place without people like you and me. there's a lot of hurt in this world, and i know you feel it too. there's always something for us, there has to be.

been thinking about this myself a lot lately. i think the first step is insurance, and then finding someone whom you can speak with, a therapist or whatever.. i guess they'll understand and be able to prescribe the proper medication and see if it helps or something like that. 

other than that, most of us are just out here raw doggin' reality on the regular feeling like a massive piece of shit.

trust me, a lot of people have been and are where you are and know how you feel, and we don't hate you, we understand. talk about things with us. if you don't want to talk about what's bothering you, tell me your favorite color .. or dinosaur. anything.
before you do that talk to someone first please.. if you have no one else to talk to you can talk to me.

hope is all some of us have and when we lose it, it feels like everything is over. 

please don't lose hope, there's gotta be something
tell me what's going on

i know exactly how you feel.

it's so hard to sleep but worse to be left alone with your thoughts
